title: ISO 19650-2 Pre-Appointment Tender-Response Sequence
applies_when: ISO 19650-2:2018 is applicable and a delivery-team tender response is being prepared
required_sequence: 5.3.2 prospective lead appointed party establishes proposed pre-appointment BEP
5.3.3 each task team assesses its capability and capacity
5.3.4 prospective lead appointed party aggregates task-team assessments into delivery-team summary
5.3.5 prospective lead appointed party establishes proposed mobilization plan
5.3.6 prospective lead appointed party establishes information-delivery risk assessment/register
5.3.7 prospective lead appointed party compiles available components into tender response

checks.check: 5.3.2 seven content groups are captured, explicitly unresolved, or governed otherwise without substitution by supplementary TIVERIT topics.
Every identified task team has separately traceable 5.3.3 evidence for information management, information production and IT availability.
5.3.4 summary aggregates rather than replaces 5.3.3 source assessments and addresses manage, produce and timely-delivery dimensions.
5.3.5 mobilization plan evaluates all eleven activity groups and records approach, timescale and responsibility for applicable activities.
5.3.6 evaluates all seven information-delivery risk groups and records intended management responses for identified risks.
5.3.7 tender-response manifest evaluates the pre-appointment BEP, capability/capacity summary, mobilization plan and information-delivery risk assessment as distinct components.
Prospective lead appointed party and task-team ISO functions are supported by project mapping; TIVERIT titles are not used as automatic substitutes.
Missing project facts/evidence remain unresolved or unavailable-with-reason and are not invented.

result_model.pass: Applicable sequence and evidence are complete and traceable.
result_model.unresolved: Required project mapping, source evidence or component availability is unresolved.
result_model.gap: Required structure or traceability is incomplete without established contradiction.
result_model.fail: Evidence shows substitution, invented facts, false completion or contradiction of the governed sequence.

provenance.note: Conformance coverage for ISO-IMP-003 Round 001; does not assert automatic ISO applicability or certification.
